warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery SDV8 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: Discovery SDV8 engines — TDV8 and SDV8, across both the D3 and D4 generations — commonly show the same timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk as the wider TDV6/SDV6 family they're based on. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 and SDV8 rebuild.
